title: Negative Stain Transmission Electron Microscopy of ATG9A Vesicles
author: Elisabeth Holzer
materials: Analyze acquired micrographs using ImageJ (RRID:SCR_003070; https://imagej.net/).

steps.title: Prepare Grids
steps.instruction: Glow discharge grids for 00:01:00 immediately before sample application to increase hydrophilicity.

steps.title: Apply Sample
steps.instruction: Apply the purified ATG9A vesicle suspension to the glow-discharged grid.

steps.title: Stain Grids
steps.instruction: Perform a two-cycle staining process using uranyl acetate.

substeps.instruction: Apply 5 µL of 2% uranyl acetate solution to the grid.
Repeat the staining step once more with fresh 2% uranyl acetate.

steps.title: Store Grids
steps.instruction: Store the dried grids under vacuum until imaging.

steps.title: Image Samples
steps.instruction: Image the stained grids using a transmission electron microscope.

substeps.instruction: Use a FEI Morgagni 268D transmission electron microscope equipped with a tungsten filament emitter, operated at 80 kV.
Acquire images at 44,000× magnification using an 11-megapixel Morada CCD camera (Olympus).
